status_note: 80 of 80 runs, four complete seeds at 20 each, 40 per arm before exclusions. One row excluded under section 3 (stopped_by: error), leaving 79 in the analysis set. Zero isolation warnings. Citable. The registered test does not reject at alpha 0.05 (p = 0.2247).
purpose: Third registered measurement, and the first through the delivery path the product actually uses: a PreToolUse hook that fires per edit and is scoped to the path being edited (#36). M1 and M1-b both handed the agent one block of text at session start.

exclusions.note: The excluded row was a control-arm re-proposal, so the rule removed a point favouring the hypothesis. Unfiltered the table is on 4/40, off 9/40, and p is unchanged to four places.

environment.delivery: PreToolUse hook via --settings, running dist/cli.js inject --hook-input per edit

known_asymmetry.note: The hook spawns a subprocess on every Edit, a cost the control never pays. A timeout truncates a run and so gives it fewer chances to re-propose, which flatters the treatment arm — the result is null anyway. Latency itself is unpriced by this benchmark.

do_not_pool: Different delivery path from M1 and M1-b, and a different n. Three measurements, not a series.

reproducibility.command: node --experimental-strip-types bench/runner.ts --tasks bench/tasks --cond commitlore-on,commitlore-off --seed 1,2,3,4 --driver claude-headless --model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --max-tokens 8000000 --timeout-ms 300000 --save-transcripts bench/results/transcripts-m2 --out bench/results/t702-m2.jsonl

not_measured.guard: SPEC section 5 assigns Ruled-out: to guard. Every measurement so far has been of injection (#37).
not_measured.hook_latency: Visible only as three timeouts; never priced directly.
